Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Ferb. What'cha wanna do today? (The paper doll Phineas falls over.) Oops! (his hand comes in to pick it up.) It's way too nice out to be lying down. (Zoom out; they are in the living room, it is raining outside.) At least...in here, it is. (Knock on the door) Come in!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (She, alongside Ginger and Holly of the Fireside Girls enter the front door of the house looking sad, while she shakes the rain drops off of her umbrella.; sad voice) Hey Phineas. What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, what's the matter?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs) We were going to go for our desert trekking patch today, but now it's raining.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You see, I know Jeremy likes me, but I don't know why he likes me. And if I find out what it is that he likes about me, I can make sure I don't change that about myself. Because what if I stop doing whatever it is that he likes? And then he stops liking me because I'm not doing it anymore?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, maybe he just likes hearing you talk.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's not like Agent P to be so... (Perry slides off the HQ chair, lands on the screen, and falls flat on his face. He and Carl laugh hysterically) Carl, play that back!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Right away, sir! (Presses play on the remote control and Perry slides on the video)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Laughs)

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Presses the slow motion button and Perry is in slow motion) Look sir, it's even funnier this way!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Laughs) Stop it, stop it. My cheeks hurt. (Perry, not finding it amusing, folds his arms) Oh uh... (Clears throat) Grow up, Carl! (Carl leaves the screen) Anyhow, as you apparently noticed there's been an unusual amount of rain in the Tri-State Area. Call us crazy, but we're thinking Doofenshmirtz! Investigate, and stop him at all costs. Well, maybe at a reasonable cost. We, I mean, we don't want to blow the whole budget on this one scheme, do we? (Perry goes to his hover car and zooms away)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Run it again, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'll get the popcorn!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, that was fast!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, nobody likes working in the rain. Let's get dry, ladies! (As Phineas, Ferb, and the Fireside Girls enter the bio-dome) This biosphere can simulate almost any environment. (Ferb pulls a lever, sand begins pouring out of the ceiling, a fake sun shines and the tiles on the inside of the biosphere turn sky blue.) Can we cook or can't we?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys are the greatest! Okay, according to the Fireside Girl handbook, we can find water in cacti. (The camera pans to a cactus. She pulls a zipper, and the cactus is revealed to have just been fabric covering a water cooler.) Now, don't make it too easy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi, Candace. What do you say to a little picnic? You know, indoors.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Neat!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: We can't let a little rain put a damper on our-- wow! (Sees the biosphere, and Candace panics) I guess your brothers have been busy, huh? Oh, we should have our picnic in there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, um... Excuse me! (Walks away from Jeremy to resolve her inner turmoil) Urge to bust so strong, but I need time with Jeremy to find out why he likes me! Gotta resist urge to bust! Must not spoil quality time with boyfriend! (Composes herself and returns to his side) Uh, picnic in the dangerous, unauthorized, and highly bust-worthy biosphere? Sounds great! (Giggles insincerely)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, we've gotten water from a cactus, witnessed a mirage, and learned the difference between sunstroke and heatstroke. Thanks for that, Adyson.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (she, who looks slightly delirious, is being dragged by Katie and Ginger.) Hey... the salamanders quit singing... (Giggles)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now we just need to either collect a sand sample, measure the temperature, or milk a camel. (A camel suddenly pops up out of the ground.) You guys!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I set up this whole thing with lasers and flypaper, falling cages, spinning platforms, on the way to a trapdoor... (The camera pans across this devious contraption) And you just come and slip on a chair, and waste a day's worth of work. Eh. (As Perry emerges from the hole in the ground in a green glass tube) But it's gonna look great on the Christmas party gag reel, hehehe! Of course, it'll just be me at the party, Yeah. uh...yeah. (Sighs) I need a laugh at the holidays. Anyway, gotcha! Go ahead, try to climb out of it. (Perry does, and simply slips on the glass.; Laughs) It's greased! So, now that you're all comfy cozy I can introduce you to my Rain-inator! I've been using it to pour millions of gallons of water into these clouds, causing it to rain all over the Tri-State Area! I-I can't believe nobody's noticed it. I-It's kind of obvious.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay! We made it across the desert! Say, Phineas, I don't suppose you could help us out with our Rainforest Navigation Patch?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, ladies. Ferb?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, this sure beats all that rain. Not too hot, are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (she, who has been laboriously fanning herself, immediately stops) No, no, not at all! I mean, isn't that what you said you liked about me? That I don't "overheat"?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heh, no. The thing I really like about you is... (There is a sudden crash. Candace yelps. Apparently, Ferb has just flipped the switch to turn the desert into a rainforest, for trees shoot up out of the ground. A pipe shoots water out, beginning to create a river) Wow, this is incredible!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, uh, what was that you were saying?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I said, This is incredible!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, before that.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I said...wow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (groans and starts to walk away; In a shallow state of calm) Pardon.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure. Hmm...

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Hey! I think I found a new species of -

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Here, Adyson! Catch this! (Throws the lasso) Swift Water Rescue Patch! Bonus!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Check it out. This umbrella makes a sweet raft. You wanna float down the river with me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still fighting between her two halves) Busting. Boyfriend. Busting. Boyfriend. Busting? Boyfriend! (Giggles) Coming!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, I bet you're wondering why did I cause all this rain. You see, while perusing local garage sales, I came upon a big screen TV from 1985. (Removes the tarp covering it) But when I went to turn it on, it was stuck on the Spanish channel! (Perry yawns and closes his eyes, clearly bored by Doof's explanation.) All it played was crazy variety shows and Mexican soap operas. (Turns on the TV) I really got hooked on one of them, though: El Matador de Amor. (Sets up his armchair to watch the soap opera.) It has three simultaneous story lines that interconnect... Genius! Anyway, the last episode was a cliffhanger... (Perry notices that Doofenshmirtz's drain pipe can fill his green glass tube with water, therefore letting him escape.) ...in which Esmerelda is going to find out why Juan loves her. At least, I think that's what's going to happen... But the show got preempted by a soccer game! Oh, I hate soccer! It makes no sense whatsoever! The clock runs up instead of counting down, what is that?! (Removes popcorn from the microwave and sits down in his armchair.) So with the help of my Rain-inator I-I rained the game out. (Camera pans to a soccer stadium full of screaming fans. It begins to rain and the fans boo.) And now, back to our regularly scheduled programming. (He turns on the TV, which is playing a commercial for an)

Name: Spanish Man on TV
Dialog: ¡La Esponja Milagroso! ("The Miracle Sponge!") Absorbes... (continues under)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: In 10 minutes, the show's gonna start, and with you trapped and the Rain-inator at work, nothing will interrupt me! (Perry takes this opportunity to start moving the tube over towards Doofenshmirtz's drain pipe.) Hey, less pounding back there, okay? I mean, you're lucky I sprang for the clear tube, this way, you can watch too!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I mean, it's like your hair was genetically engineered to ensnare those giant fruit bats.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you like that about me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It's certainly interesting, but...it's not what I like about you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What then?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, let me put it in a song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (shrieks) So, y-you were saying?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, yeah...

Name: Candace
Dialog: AHH!! Not again!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAGH!!!!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, guys! Uh-oh, here comes the fun part!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AHH!! Fun part?! Seriously?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Jungle Navigation Patch: complete! Anybody up for a little rock-climbing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold Mount Ferbius!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (A falling rock hits Adyson in the head) Sorry, Adyson.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: The salamanders are back...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who wants a Concussion First Aid Patch?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Incoming!!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (As he moves his arms and legs back and forth) Ha, hey, look, Candace, I'm making snow angels.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grumpily) I'm wet and I'm freezing cold.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, it's not so bad. I mean, we're together, aren't we?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah...

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (As the Fireside Girls climb the mountain, she slips and kicks a boulder, inadvertently sending it towards Candace and Jeremy) Eeek! Whoops.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And being together like this makes me realize what I like about you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Excitedly) What? What??? (The boulder whistles as it falls, and she and Jeremy notice it.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What's that sound? (The boulder lands about ten feet away from them.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That could've squished us! That's it! I am gonna bust them!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (As Candace stomps away angrily) Wait, Candace, look! It's just papier-mâché! (Lifts the boulder easily)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good job, everyone. I think we've earned our Rock Climbing Patches.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In a hang-glider) Congratulations, ladies. How do you feel about Non-Powered Flight Patches?

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: (Cheer)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Marvelous!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! (They all fly off the top of the mountain)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (reaches it) Hey, get back here! I'm gonna bust you two if it's the last thing I-- (The cliff crumbles from her body weight, and she falls. She is barely hanging on to a tiny little crevice in the rock and hyperventilating)

Name: Spanish Man on TV
Dialog: El Matador de Amor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (As sappy guitar music plays in the background) It's starting! It's starting!!! Okay, now, Perry the Platypus, shhh. (Camera pans to Perry, who has nearly filled his tube trap with water.) I do-I don't want to miss anything.

Name: Esmerelda
Dialog: Oh, Juan...

Name: Juan
Dialog: Por lo Tanto su manada gemela, ha sido en Venenado...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still barely hanging on to the remaining part of the cliff; Screams) Help me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hold on, Candace, I'll save you! (He jumps off the cliff, using the giant umbrella as a parachute. He grabs her just as she is about to fall) I got you, Candace! (They float down to the bottom and out of the biosphere, onto the front lawn.) Oh, man, I love this umbrella!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, kids!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, Candace, I was trying to say back there that...well, the thing I like about you is...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Hold that thought! I'll be right back. (She runs over to Linda in her usual fashion.) Mom! Mom! Backyard! Now! Biosphere!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (from inside) He's getting closer...he's looking into her eyes! (Perry attaches a grappling hook to a passing airplane.) He's opening his mouth! (Perry ties the other end to the Rain-inator) He's forming his lips to start to articulate the syllables! Tell her, Juan! Tell her why you love her!!!

Name: Juan
Dialog: Es! La razón porque te amo (Repeat) La razón porque te amos es... es... (The airplane pulls the Rain-inator away, clearing the sky of the rain. The soccer fans cheer in the stadium.) Es!

Name: Sport Announcer
Dialog: ¡Ahi Van la Pelota!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?! No!!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's right here, Mom! Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Phineas/Fireside Girls
Dialog: Hi, Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (enters) Hmm, I've really got to fix the latch on that gate. (Both turn around and see the empty backyard; Candace facepalms.) Ummm...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How is this possible? I took every precaution! I had the Rain-inator, I had you trapped in a - what the? (Perry, standing next to the gushing remains of the Rain-inator, salutes and hops into his hovercraft.) ¡Maldito seas, Perry el Ornitorrinco! Man, this is gonna cost me a fortune on my water bill.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, did you ever find out why Jeremy likes you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (realizes) Jeremy! (She bolts over to him.) Now, please continue your thought. Tell me why you like me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You bet! The reason that I like you is...

Name: Sport Announcer
Dialog: ¡Viene, le pega! ¡GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOL!
